ExcludedSourceRecord.title: ExcludedSourceRecord
ExcludedSourceRecord.description: A complete nonblank source record outside every incident. Original decoded CSV text includes its original line endings and quoting.

ExactDurationMicroseconds.title: ExactDurationMicroseconds
ExactDurationMicroseconds.description: Canonical ASCII decimal whole string in the inclusive range 0..315537897599999999 microseconds. The alphabet rejection also closes end-anchor trailing-linefeed differences across regex engines.

ExactClockMicroseconds.title: ExactClockMicroseconds
ExactClockMicroseconds.description: Canonical ASCII signed decimal whole string in the inclusive range -62135596800000000..253402300799999999; native microseconds since 1970-01-01 on the declared UTC or wall clock. Calendar validity and correspondence to the timestamp key remain semantic requirements.

IncidentUtcTimestampKey.title: IncidentUtcTimestampKey
IncidentUtcTimestampKey.description: Canonical ASCII timestamp in normalized calendar years 0001..9999. A calendar-aware producer guard rejects invalid dates, invalid times, trailing data, and a clock inconsistent with this branch.

IncidentWallTimestampKey.title: IncidentWallTimestampKey
IncidentWallTimestampKey.description: Canonical ASCII timestamp in normalized calendar years 0001..9999. A calendar-aware producer guard rejects invalid dates, invalid times, trailing data, and a clock inconsistent with this branch.
